title: Cart total omits the shipping charge
description: When the cart subtotal is below the free-shipping threshold, the displayed Total shows only the merchandise subtotal instead of subtotal plus the visible shipping charge.

steps: Observe the Shipping and Total values
report.expected: With a .00 Keyboard and .00 shipping, Total should display .00.
report.context: Fresh browser storage and an initially empty cart.

preconditions: Cart contains items with a subtotal below the free‑shipping threshold
Free‑shipping threshold is configured in the system
The shipping charge is visible on the cart page
User is viewing the cart page
steps: 1. Add items to the cart so that the merchandise subtotal is below the free‑shipping threshold.
2. Verify that the shipping charge is displayed next to the subtotal.
3. Observe the value shown in the Total field.
reproduction.expected: The displayed Total should show the merchandise subtotal plus the visible shipping charge.
reproduction.actual: The displayed Total shows only the merchandise subtotal, omitting the shipping charge.
